meta_description: A guide for partners of the Geneva Solution Space: desks, meeting rooms, the ground-floor space, the Fab Lab and events.

hero.title: A guide for
hero.lede: What the Geneva Solution Space offers the organizations in its ecosystem, and how to use it: desks, meeting rooms, the ground-floor space, the Fab Lab and events.

desk.alt: The 7th-floor partner space at Campus Biotech Innovation Park
desk.title: Your desk on
paragraphs: The associated co-working space on the 7th floor of Campus Biotech Innovation Park hosts desks for up to 14 partner institutions, with 3 adjacent meeting rooms for video calls and small group discussions.
Desks are rented for periods of one year, renewable, and the Geneva Solution Space can serve as your Geneva address.

items.text: Three meeting rooms next to the 7th-floor desks, plus rooms across CBIP and the main Campus Biotech building — see [how to book them](/partners/#meeting-rooms).

The 330m² space can be configured as a lecture room, a space for team-based project work, or a convivial meeting area — up to 60 people seated, 90 standing. Check availability and request a booking on the reservations page.
A 40m² kitchen for coffee breaks and apéros, and a 5m² Zoom Room for hybrid meetings.
The 60m² Fab Lab can be booked on its own, by the hour or the day, with partner AddictLab available to introduce your group to the machines.
Host workshops, trainings, launches and panels in the space, and take part in the ecosystem's own formats — the IApéro evenings and the hackademIA hackathons, where partners set the challenges.
Partners appear on the ecosystem wheel on our homepage, alongside the University of Geneva and the International Organizations around Campus Biotech.
Three meeting rooms next to the partner desks — Mont-Blanc, Salève and Jura — bookable by ecosystem members. Bookings are made on the shared Google Sheet; ask the team for the link.
Ground floor: Newton (16 people). 2nd floor: Vesta and Orion (16 people each, can be merged into one large room). 8th floor: Galilée (8 people). Book them on the Campus Biotech MyCampus platform.
Meeting rooms in the main building of Campus Biotech are booked on the same MyCampus platform — create an account first. [biotech.pocketcampus.org ↗](https://biotech.pocketcampus.org/dashboard)

band.title: Book the
band.text: Bookings for the ground-floor space, the Fab Lab and the Zoom Room go through the reservations page: pick a date on the calendar and send a request. Meeting rooms are booked as described above.

list.title: Current
list.lede: The organizations listed below are partners of the Geneva Solution Space in 2026, most of them renting desks in our 7th floor co-working space. Together, they contribute to a vibrant ecosystem within the Campus Biotech Innovation Park.
list.lede2: If you are an international NGO, association or start-up working in the areas of human development and sustainability, and are interested to join, please [contact us](/contact/).
